identifier: FAQ: Do you offer a free trial?
statement: Yes, we offer a fully functional 15-day free trial, during which you can test drive BigCommerce and build your site. You don't need a credit card to sign up; there's no obligation and no risk.

identifier: FAQ: Can I launch a store and complete transactions during my trial?
statement: Yes, our 15-day free trial is a fully-functional product that would allow you to launch a store and take payments. You will need to set up a payments partner to accept payments and complete transactions.

identifier: FAQ: What happens to my store at the end of my trial?
statement: We’ll send you a reminder to upgrade your store at the end of your free trial. If you choose not to upgrade, we’ll keep your data for 90 days — just choose a subscription plan to get your store up and running again. During this time, your customers won’t be able to access your store, and you’ll only be able to log in to choose a plan. After 90 days, your store will be automatically deleted, and we’ll no longer be able to restore it.

identifier: PayPal Braintree rate: (1) qualifying BigCommerce Plan
statement: (1) If you are a new BigCommerce Merchant using a trial PayPal Braintree account, you will need to select a qualifying BigCommerce Plan (Growth, Scale, or Performance). Go into your BigCommerce account Client Area and accept the terms of the selected BigCommerce plan and establish a billing agreement. You will then be charged the first month’s fee for your BigCommerce plan, and you will become eligible to apply for the negotiated payment processing rates with PayPal Braintree. If you are an existing BigCommerce Merchant already in a Growth, Scale, or Performance plan, you do not need to complete this step.

identifier: PCI Compliance: Who is required to provide proof of compliance?
statement: PCI compliance applies to any merchant or organization that accepts, transmits, or stores any cardholder data, regardless of size. If you accept transactions from customers using credit or debit cards, the PCI DSS requirements apply. BigCommerce is a PCI DSS compliant service provider and certifies annually all requirements (1-12) included as a shared hosting provider.
The ultimate responsibility of PCI compliance lies with you and takes into consideration the architecture of your e-commerce store and multiple channels of integrations.

Make sure your payment pages are PCI Compliant! If you are adding scripts to customize any of your payment pages, including checkout, web pages, and the My Account page, you must add a subresource integrity (SRI) hash to ensure these pages are secure and maintain PCI compliance.

identifier: Changing Your Default Currency; Settings › Currencies
statement: To change your store's default currency, you will first need to add the currency that you want to be the new default, if it’s not already present in your store. Once this is done, go to Settings › Currencies, and click Action › Set as default next to the desired currency.
